business: Northwind Studio, a small design studio (sample data)

meeting-request.rule: Asks to schedule a call or meeting. Reply offers the booking link; never confirms a time.

order-status.rule: Asks where an order or delivery is, with no complaint about damage or money.

faq.rule: Asks a question answered by the written FAQ (opening hours, pricing page, turnaround, file formats).

thanks.rule: Only says thanks or confirms receipt. Reply is a short acknowledgement.

billing.rule: Refunds, chargebacks, invoice disputes, payment problems. Money is always a human decision.

complaint.rule: Unhappy customer, damaged or wrong goods, threats to leave a review.

legal-security.rule: Legal notices, contracts, GDPR/data requests, security reports, press.

sales-lead.rule: A new prospect asking for a quote or project scope. A person should answer.

spam.rule: Unsolicited promotion, SEO offers, phishing. No reply, no queue.

other.rule: Anything that fits no label. Never guess: a person decides.

faq.turnaround: Standard projects take 5 to 7 working days after briefing.
faq.formats: We deliver PNG, SVG and PDF; source files (Figma, AI) on request.
